icc_desc: Choose each cleanup feature independently. Changes affect future cleanup and impacts; removed objects cannot be restored.
icc_remove_corpses_desc: Removes dead enemies and civilians immediately in loud. Preserves bodies in stealth for body bags. OFF: normal game corpse disposal.
icc_remove_shields_desc: Removes dropped shields in loud using native cleanup checks every 0.1 seconds. OFF: normal game shield disposal. Does not remove shields held by living enemies.
icc_remove_props_title: Remove props dropped by dead units
icc_remove_props_desc: Prevents loose helmets and bulldozer armor debris: face plates, chest, back, abdomen and neck. OFF: normal cosmetic debris.
icc_remove_decals_title: Remove blood splatters and bullet holes
icc_remove_decals_desc: Prevents new surface blood splatters, bullet holes and explosion scorch marks, including grenade-launcher and synchronized multiplayer impacts. OFF: normal impact decals.
